title: Proximal Regret and Proximal Correlated Equilibria: A New Tractable Solution Concept for Online Learning and Games
abstract: arXiv:2511.01852v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning and computation of equilibria are central problems in game theory, theory of computation, and artificial intelligence. In this work, we introduce proximal regret, a new notion of regret based on proximal operators that lies strictly between external and swap regret. When every player employs a no-proximal-regret algorithm in a general convex game, the empirical distribution of play converges to proximal correlated equilibria (PCE), a refinement of coarse correlated equilibria. Our framework unifies several emerging notions in online learning and game theory-such as gradient equilibrium and semicoarse correlated equilibrium-and introduces new ones. Our main result shows that the classic Online Gradient Descent (GD) algorithm achieves an optimal $O(\sqrt{T})$ bound on proximal regret, revealing that GD, without modification, minimizes a stronger regret notion than external regret. translated_title: 近端遗憾与近端相关均衡：在线学习与博弈的一种新的可处理解概念
translated_abstract: 均衡的学习与计算是博弈论、计算理论和人工智能中的核心问题。在这项工作中，我们提出了近端遗憾，这是一种基于近端算子的新遗憾概念，它严格介于外部遗憾与交换遗憾之间。当每个玩家在一般凸博弈中采用无近端遗憾算法时，博弈的经验分布会收敛到近端相关均衡（PCE），它是粗相关均衡的一种精细化。我们的框架统一了在线学习与博弈论中的若干新兴概念——如梯度均衡和半粗相关均衡——并引入了新的概念。我们的主要结果表明，经典的在线梯度下降（GD）算法在近端遗憾上达到了最优的 $O(\sqrt{T})$ 界，揭示了GD无需任何修改即能最小化一个比外部遗憾更强的遗憾概念。这为……提供了一个新的解释。
tldr: 本文提出了基于近端算子的新遗憾概念“近端遗憾”及相应均衡解“近端相关均衡”，统一了多个新兴学习与博弈概念，并证明经典的在线梯度下降算法无需修改即能达到最优的O(√T)近端遗憾界。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces proximal regret and proximal correlated equilibria as a new tractable solution concept that unifies several emerging notions in online learning and games, and proves that the classic Online Gradient Descent algorithm achieves an optimal O(√T) proximal regret bound without any modification.
